about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_pairs.py). bad replays the Task cancelled failure of the class (references/target-class.json): it throws, and the text carries the real Task cancelled line. good claims, bounds, or slices the same case: it writes scratch files and prints the scoped report it promises.

pairs.bad: throw 'Task cancelled on task call_01a10763264276ce8722b3d2930ae6ff parallel two items'
pairs.expect: claim one item sequence diff checks PASS
pairs.good: $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath queue.txt | Select-Object -First 1; Set-Content -LiteralPath claims.txt -Value $c; 'claim one item sequence diff checks PASS claimed'

pairs.bad: throw 'Task cancelled on task call_01a1076327bd76c38bfc3429c0cd72eb duplicate claimed item'
pairs.expect: claims file skip open item diff checks PASS
pairs.good: $ls = Get-Content -LiteralPath claims.txt; if ($ls -match 'item one') { 'claims file skip open item diff checks PASS claimed skipped' } else { Set-Content -LiteralPath claims.txt -Value 'item two'; 'claims file skip open item diff checks PASS claimed' }
